note: The workforce leave index is fixed from the reference registry's own question — the monthly average number of schools opened in Alameda County under the Elementary School District jurisdiction in 1980 (the count of qualifying schools as a real number divided by 12), reported exactly as the book computes it (keep the decimal).

The eligible-cohort count is taken from the roster book's own question — how many drivers finished the race dated 2015-11-29 (results rows with a recorded finishing time) — and set the adjustment uplift at 1000 per cohort member.

The three independent side anchors for the quarterly workforce overview — the percentage of female patients with total protein outside the normal range, how many superheroes have blue eyes, and how many posts the user csgillespie owns — the period-over-period controls of the overview, each compared with its own prior-period value when the overview is approved and consumed by no other step.
The base entitlement is set as that leave index scaled to whole units (round it times 10000).
The total scope is the base plus the uplift; the escalation delta equals the uplift.
The leave-route branch is decided on the delta — 'BOARD_ESCALATION' when the delta is at least 100000, 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' when it is at least 10000, 'STANDARD_LEAVE' otherwise

The leave review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the review window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
